title: Plants-vs-Zoombie Inspired Game, made in way too little sleep
author: Yanxi_Tracy
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1pk4g5v/video/iwb1fa0v7m6g1/player

I was just “checking out this one mechanic” and suddenly I’m knee-deep in:

sun-economy tweaks  
a zombified boss that absolutely shouldn’t move that fast  
and a lane system that exists only because I wanted to test a goofy spawn script lol

Anyway, the game is called **PLANTS vs ZOOBIE (Gambo-style)** — basically a tiny PVZ-inspired chaos experiment built in Gambo.ai. Still super rough, still janky, but somehow way more fun than I expected.

If you wanna poke at the build (no pressure):  
*your link here* [https://www.gambo.ai/projects/60684?copyKey=9d141ead-f0e0-4dc1-bf95-5188c7e4e2cf](https://www.gambo.ai/projects/60684?copyKey=9d141ead-f0e0-4dc1-bf95-5188c7e4e2cf)

comments.author: xJohn_Snow
comments.body: I love the chaotic energy and creativity, especially how you experimented with sun-economy tweaks, the fast zombie boss, and the lane system. The rough edges actually add charm, and I can see a lot of potential if you refine mechanics further. If you want more detailed feedback and suggestions, you might consider uploading it to [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com), users there actively test projects and provide detailed input. Definitely a playful, engaging experiment!
